svg.aria-label: Figure 2.8: UML State Machine Diagram — Webmed Healthcare

g.text: exit / required resources have been accessed
entry / when the user is a new user
entry / user must be logged in
do / selection and usage of desired facilities
exit / selected facility can be accessed
entry / when user has chosen news and experts
entry / when user has chosen symptoms checker
do / get symptoms and fetch the disease
entry / when user has chosen check fitness
do / get details and calculate fitness

svg.text: [ user needs to access the resources again ]

g.text: entry / when user is delivered with drugs
exit / user is prompted to pay during delivery
entry / when doctor is consulted or drugs are purchased
do / check insurance details and make payment
entry / user has opted to give feedback

svg.text: [ user isn't willing to give feedback ]
[ user needs to logout the system ]

g.text: entry / when user opts to logout
exit / user will be logged out
Architectural Scope: The Webmed State Machine governs user lifecycle progression from registration check through the comprehensive composite Login Sub-Machine to checkout, feedback, and logout.
Built strictly according to UML specifications: zero raster dependencies, 100% vector typography, active CSS directional animation, light/dark theme reactive.
